nodes.label: The Section 0 Gate
nodes.rationale: Each step its own call: confirm the checkout, run verify.py, census, run --core, manifest, the previous chat's instruments, then cert. Any FAIL stops the chat with a report. Nothing is fetched from Drive.

nodes.label: The Repository as Store of Record
nodes.rationale: M's chat-151 ruling. Suspended at chat 151-B's open for as long as GitHub is unreachable from Cowork: the GitHub App token 404s the private repository even with all repositories granted, no add_repo is provisioned, and Drive does not resolve from the container. Drive remains archive and original-input witness under Ruling 56, no longer on the read path.

nodes.label: method/verify.py
nodes.rationale: The tree is a witness, not a convenience copy: verify.py checks every member against its recorded size and md5, then splices every member back into its bundle at the recorded offset and asserts the bundle's own md5. A checkout that passes it provably reproduces what the old Drive gate used to extract.

nodes.label: The Two Registers
nodes.rationale: The Register is a compendium recording subject matter only and is cited in the other volumes; WORKING-REGISTER.md is the audit log where every reader-perspective audit, editorial entry and finding goes, and it is forbidden from the books.

nodes.label: Lambda-8 and the Tower
nodes.rationale: 976 cells, 8 coordinates, 7 Heaviside constraints, with the tower Lambda-9 to Lambda-13 (1,654 / 2,535 / 13,585 / 70,905 / 199,130) rebuilt by tower-2.py at caps (3, 3, 1, 3, 1). Imported by path via r2lib.load_tower, never copied.

nodes.label: No Silent Change
nodes.rationale: A volume may not change unless a Register entry in the same build records it. Every edit is a measured diff with count-asserted substitutions and a reverse-md5 guard. It is why a build that seated entries and left the main md5 alone would mean the counts had NOT been re-taken.

nodes.label: Register Entries Are Append-Only
nodes.rationale: Never removed, relocated or renumbered; a superseded entry is corrected by a new entry that cites it, and both states are preserved. Moving an entry out is a deletion. A Register number is assigned at seating, and a number is never reused - which is why 1797 stays a hole.

nodes.label: Ruling 46 - no internal references visible to readers
nodes.rationale: No script names, build numbers or internal file references in a reader-facing volume. It is the class behind every C13-HANDLE-LEAK census row.

nodes.label: Ruling 45 - no editorial process in a reader-facing volume
tools/close_vol.py - the fourth close route
nodes.rationale: Built because a compendium had no route into the store at all: close.py refuses any change to a seated member, close_main.py writes only the Register, close_rebank.py only a golden, close_census.py only the census. Count-asserted substitutions, no member added or removed, the W text appended in the same build, and a reverse guard that must reproduce the old bundle's md5.

nodes.label: tools/gate_live.py
nodes.rationale: The live walk over the live golden set plus a --census step; --list prints the live set and the reason every other golden is left out. gate.py census stays red by construction and gate.py run --all reports nothing the held list does not.

nodes.label: The method/bin Python 3.12 Shim
nodes.rationale: gate.py runs every instrument as 'python3 NAME.py', hard-coded, and several seated members do not parse before 3.12. Without the shim four goldens differ from their banked output by a SyntaxError traceback and read FAIL - and close_rebank.py regenerates by RUNNING, so a re-bank would have banked the tracebacks as the goldens, after which verify.py and the census both still pass.

nodes.label: The Prime Zeno Directive
nodes.rationale: Every action runs in segments - fetch/search, read/encode, analysis, downstream flags, report - and each is closed (files written, md5s measured, golden banked) before the next opens. Never leave a segment half-done.

nodes.label: R-FORM and R-ATTR
nodes.rationale: Descriptive title, bold dense headline with section pointers on first mention, italic scope-caps line, Proved/Computed plus citation chain, blockquote Prior art; all attributions that can be made are made. No object handles or workshop jargon in reader-facing volumes - cross-references name the object by its descriptive title.

nodes.label: A Reconstruction That Disagrees Is About the Reconstruction
nodes.rationale: Never withdraw a recorded finding on reconstructed evidence without the original instrument, and never change an instrument to make a discrepancy disappear.

nodes.label: A Count Wrong Because the Pattern Was Narrower Than the Material
nodes.rationale: M's correction landed inside an instrument rather than a question three times: compendia3.py's dotted parent regex reported 14 where the figure was 73; register 1736's author-and-year match was blind to a wrong year on a real author; and compendia2.py sought the bracket-system object by the name it would have borne had it been absent, so a search shaped to find an absence found one.

nodes.label: The bibindex Derivation Chain
nodes.rationale: bibindex, bibindex2, bibindex3 and bibindex4 are one derivation chain, so one successor discharges all three predecessors. The whole chain had moved, not the one figure the hold named: DERIVED 127 to 143, IMPORT-OWED 21 to 8, LEDGER 2 to 0, and NO-ATTRIBUTION-FOUND still zero.

nodes.label: The Barette / Barták Co-Author Correction
nodes.rationale: Three volumes printed the wrong form against one printing the right one, so by weight of sites the correct volume looked like the outlier. A majority of citations is not a fact about a name. Every prior pass verified the internal triangle - text, References, Register - and none checked the author list.
